metadata.description: Shared practices, tools, and workflows for working with Claude

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workflow: grouped conventional commits with QA and hook compliance, template-driven pull requests, merged-branch purge across local and remote, and a hook that redirects a second PR against the default branch to a stack

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian dashboard sync skills: resolve the active client by discovery and read/write a Dashboard.md without hardcoding client names

plugins.name: wrap
plugins.description: End-of-day, end-of-session and agent-handover wrap skills: reconcile the Obsidian dashboard and prune git at day end; extract learnings for the next session; write a vault handover an agent with no context can act on

plugins.name: dependabot
plugins.description: Dependabot lifecycle skills: scan repositories for alert coverage and open PRs, then onboard a repo with alerts, grouped update config, and auto-merge on green

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: Day-planning skills: the next task picked and started for one client, and the day's plate across all clients from the Obsidian dashboard, with weekend fall-forward and tracker-first sourcing

plugins.name: tone
plugins.description: Documentation tone skill: plain language, banned filler and empty modifiers, UK English, and export-safe markdown structure for markdown, Word, PDF, and HTML deliverables, with a copyable **/*.md rule that points back to the skill

plugins.name: mail
plugins.description: Junk-mail triage for Microsoft 365: read-only inventory, keep/delete table, then rescue-to-Inbox and recoverable delete only after approval.
